title: Acyclicity of the Negation Gates
statement: For every natural number $n$, the list of $n$ gates that negate the input vertices $0,1,\\ldots,n-1$ is acyclic: for each gate at position $i$ and each vertex it reads, that vertex has index less than $n+i$.
